verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents cloud sessions in the browser for long-running tasks on repos you don't have locally. It also documents planning, writing and verifying code, running tests, and submitting PRs for review, so the build-and-test-in-the-cloud core is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent producing a demo artifact (preview deployment, screenshots, or recording) for the reviewer. One hands-on user reports that its self-verification can't be trusted, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: demo artifacts for review, explicit documentation that cloud sessions run tests end-to-end, and independent corroboration of reliable cloud verification.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Run Claude Code in your browser with no local setup. Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done, work on repos you don't have locally, or run multiple tasks in parallel.
Claude Code plans the approach, writes the code across multiple files, and verifies it works.
